name: Advanced Queue Mail
description: Sends configurable email notifications when Advanced Queue jobs succeed, are retried, or permanently fail.
project_description: Advanced Queue Mail sends email notifications for Advanced Queue job events. It subscribes to the JOB_SUCCESS, JOB_RETRY and JOB_FAILURE events dispatched by the advancedqueue module and, for each event type that is enabled, emails a configured recipient list. Subject and body are admin-configured templates supporting the placeholders [job_id], [job_type], [queue_id], [message] and [state], which are substituted with values from the completed job. By default it uses Drupal core's mail system; the bundled advancedqueue_mail_symfony_mailer submodule swaps the sender for Mailer Plus (Symfony Mailer) so emails can be built with policies, HTML templates and attachments. Configuration lives in a single config object and is edited at Administration > Configuration > System > Queues > Mail Notifications.
